description: A shell script used for testing git fast-import functionality with various commit and notes scenarios, including creating commits, adding notes, updating notes, deleting notes, and bulk operations to test fanout and performance characteristics.

methods.name: fast_import_commits
methods.description: Generates a specified number of commits using fast-import commands appended to a file.

methods.name: fast_import_notes
methods.description: Generates notes for commits, attaching them via fast-import commands, and optionally appending custom note content.
